Borrow $10 of USDC against the deposit on Swan DAO and repay it within a week, so the wallet shows both sides of the market. Cost: about $10 of capital and $2 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.
Make one qualifying action each week on Ethereum, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot, and do not withdraw and re-deposit to game it. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page from its official site and claim only from the link it publishes; never pay a fee to claim and never trust a link sent to you. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log, then unwind in reverse — claim, withdraw the second chain first, then the main position — and keep only money you can afford to lose in the protocol. Cost: nothing but the log, plus about $4 of exit gas. Time: 15 minutes to unwind.
